reason: The reviews with real photos, the UL number and free returns calm me down a lot, and $249 isn't crazy. But I'd pin it to my dining room board with the other 40 and wait until the room actually comes together, so I wouldn't buy this month.
objection: It's still a brand I've never heard of, and a paper pendant that looks great in a listing photo might look cheap in my room. 60 reviews is not many.
would_change_my_mind: The dining room being painted and ready, plus a review photo of this exact pendant over a table in a room like mine. Or a cheaper sample of the paper material.
